question: Who is the winner of World Games Athlete of the Year Award 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rani Rampal.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Rani Rampal has been nominated for the ‘World Games Athlete of the Year’ Award, 2019 by the International Hockey Federation (FIH).
 
• 'World Games Athlete of the Year' award has been the first time won by a hockey player.
 
• Rani Rampal has received Padmashree award, one of the highest civilian awards of our country in 2020.
